blocks.zh: 一次性使用系統採用之商業驅動因素
blocks.en: Business Drivers for the Adoption of Single-Use Systems

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解驅動企業採用 Single-Use Systems (SUS) 的關鍵商業因素與評估框架
blocks.en: Understand the key business drivers and evaluation framework that lead companies to adopt Single-Use Systems (SUS)

blocks.zh: 掌握 Lifecycle Approach (生命週期方法) 與 Opportunity Cost (機會成本) 在 SUS 決策中的應用
blocks.en: Master the application of the Lifecycle Approach and Opportunity Cost in SUS decisions

blocks.zh: 學習 Cost of Goods Manufactured (COGM) 模型的結構，包含 Process Model、Operational Model、Variable Cost 及 Fixed Cost 子模型
blocks.en: Learn the structure of the Cost of Goods Manufactured (COGM) model, including the Process Model, Operational Model, Variable Cost and Fixed Cost submodels

blocks.zh: 理解 Investment Costs (投資成本) 的組成因素，包括設備、設施、公用設施及間接成本
blocks.en: Understand the components of Investment Costs, including equipment, facility, utilities and indirect costs

blocks.zh: 認識 SUS 實施對 QC/QA 品質成本及固定營運成本的影響
blocks.en: Recognize the impact of SUS implementation on QC/QA cost of quality and on fixed operating costs

blocks.zh: 本節目錄 Section Contents
blocks.en: Section Contents

blocks.zh: 6.0 Business Drivers for the Adoption of Single-Use Systems 6.0 採用一次性使用系統之商業驅動因素
blocks.en: 6.0 Business Drivers for the Adoption of Single-Use Systems

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Business Drivers (商業驅動因素)：指促使企業決定採用 SUS 的各種商業考量，包括成本、彈性、速度、法規合規等。每家公司的驅動因素組合都不同，取決於其商業模式。
blocks.en: Business Drivers: The various business considerations that lead a company to adopt SUS, including cost, flexibility, speed and regulatory compliance. Every company has a different mix of drivers, depending on its business model.

blocks.zh: Hybrid Approach (混合方法)：同時使用 SUS 與傳統 Multi-Use Systems (MUS) 的策略，在降低變動成本的同時保持產能擴充彈性。
blocks.en: Hybrid Approach: A strategy that uses SUS together with traditional Multi-Use Systems (MUS), reducing variable cost while retaining flexibility to expand capacity.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你在開一家餐廳。你可以選擇全部使用瓷器餐具 (MUS)，需要洗碗機和專人清洗；或全部使用免洗餐具 (SUS)，省去清洗但每餐耗材成本較高；或者混合使用 — 主餐用瓷盤、飲料用紙杯 (Hybrid)。最佳選擇取決於你的餐廳類型：高級餐廳、快餐店、還是外燴服務商 (CMO)？
blocks.en: Imagine you run a restaurant. You could use porcelain tableware throughout (MUS), which requires a dishwasher and dedicated staff to wash up; or use disposable tableware throughout (SUS), which eliminates washing but costs more in consumables for every meal; or mix the two, with porcelain plates for main courses and paper cups for drinks (Hybrid). The best choice depends on what kind of restaurant you run: fine dining, fast food, or a catering service (CMO)?

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: TR66 強調：SUS 的評估必須從了解企業本身的商業模式開始。CMO 最重視交叉污染防控，單一產品工廠可能偏好 Hybrid 方案，而新建工廠則可能完全採用 SUS 設計。沒有「一體適用」的答案。
blocks.en: TR66 emphasizes that the evaluation of SUS must start with an understanding of the company's own business model. A CMO places the most weight on preventing cross-contamination, a single-product plant may prefer a Hybrid approach, and a new facility may adopt an entirely SUS-based design. There is no "one size fits all" answer.

blocks.zh: 注意原文列出的八大評估因素，涵蓋了從供應商能力到預期設廠地點的完整範圍 — 這不只是「成本比較」，而是全方位的商業策略評估。
blocks.en: Note that the original text lists eight evaluation factors, covering everything from supplier capability to the intended plant location. This is not just a "cost comparison" but a full business strategy assessment.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 如果你是一家 CMO 的營運主管，為什麼「消除交叉污染」可能比「降低成本」更重要？
blocks.en: If you were an operations head at a CMO, why might "eliminating cross-contamination" matter more than "reducing cost"?

blocks.zh: Hybrid approach 在什麼情境下最具優勢？請舉出至少兩個具體場景。
blocks.en: In what situations does a hybrid approach offer the greatest advantage? Give at least two specific scenarios.

blocks.zh: 6.1 Evaluation of Business Drivers 6.1 商業驅動因素評估
blocks.en: 6.1 Evaluation of Business Drivers

blocks.zh: COGM (製造成本)：Cost of Goods Manufactured，是衡量每批次產品製造總成本的關鍵指標。它將所有營運成本與資本成本除以批次數量，得出單位批次成本，用於比較 SUS 與 MUS 的經濟可行性。
blocks.en: COGM (Cost of Goods Manufactured): A key metric for the total cost of manufacturing each batch of product. It divides all operating and capital costs by the number of batches to give a cost per batch, which is used to compare the economic viability of SUS and MUS.

blocks.zh: Value-Stream Mapping (價值流圖)：精實製造工具，用於視覺化整個製程流程中的增值與非增值步驟，幫助識別可用 SUS 取代的浪費環節。
blocks.en: Value-Stream Mapping: A lean manufacturing tool that visualizes the value-adding and non-value-adding steps across the whole process flow, helping to identify wasteful steps that SUS could replace.

blocks.zh: 評估 SUS 不能只看「看得見的成本節省」（tangible savings），還必須考量「難以量化的效益」（less quantitative benefits），例如降低交叉污染風險。這些軟性效益在法規審查和產品品質層面往往更具決定性。
blocks.en: An SUS evaluation cannot look only at "visible cost savings" (tangible savings); it must also consider "less quantitative benefits", such as reduced risk of cross-contamination. These soft benefits are often more decisive for regulatory review and product quality.

blocks.zh: 原文提到的評估工具組合 — COGM + Risk Assessment + Value-Stream Mapping + CO2 Footprint — 反映了現代製藥業對 SUS 決策的全面性要求，不再只是財務部門的工作。
blocks.en: The combination of evaluation tools mentioned in the original text (COGM + Risk Assessment + Value-Stream Mapping + CO2 Footprint) reflects the modern pharmaceutical industry's expectation of a comprehensive approach to SUS decisions; it is no longer solely a finance department task.

blocks.zh: 就像買車不能只看售價 — 你還要考慮油耗、維修費、保險、折舊，甚至對環境的影響。COGM 分析就是 SUS 決策的「買車全生命週期成本 (TCO)」計算器。
blocks.en: It is like buying a car: you cannot look only at the sticker price. You also have to consider fuel consumption, maintenance, insurance, depreciation and even the environmental impact. COGM analysis is the "total cost of ownership (TCO)" calculator for the SUS decision.

blocks.zh: 請列舉三項 SUS 實施帶來的「可量化成本節省」和三項「難以量化的效益」。
blocks.en: List three "quantifiable cost savings" and three "less quantitative benefits" that SUS implementation can bring.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 CO2 footprint 和 green manufacturing 也被列為評估工具？這對藥廠的商業決策有何影響？
blocks.en: Why are CO2 footprint and green manufacturing also listed as evaluation tools? What does this mean for a pharmaceutical company's business decisions?

blocks.zh: 6.2 Lifecycle Approach 6.2 生命週期方法
blocks.en: 6.2 Lifecycle Approach

blocks.zh: Lifecycle Approach (生命週期方法)：評估專案從建設到除役 (decommissioning) 整個生命週期中所有成本的方法。不只看初始投資，還包括營運、品質管理開銷、以及最終的設備拆除成本。
blocks.en: Lifecycle Approach: A method that evaluates all costs of a project over its entire lifecycle, from construction to decommissioning. It looks beyond the initial investment to include operations, quality management overhead and the eventual cost of dismantling equipment.

blocks.zh: Operational Flexibility (營運彈性)：製造設施快速適應產量變化、產品切換或市場需求波動的能力。SUS 因較少依賴固定設備和公用設施安裝，天然具有較高的營運彈性。
blocks.en: Operational Flexibility: The ability of a manufacturing facility to adapt quickly to changes in volume, product changeovers or market demand fluctuations. Because SUS depends less on fixed equipment and utility installations, it inherently offers greater operational flexibility.

blocks.zh: 生命週期方法就像評估「租房 vs 買房」的決策：租房 (SUS) 初期投入低、搬家方便，但每月租金較高；買房 (MUS) 需要大額頭期款和裝潢費用，但長期使用成本可能較低。最佳選擇取決於你預計住多久、是否會需要搬遷、以及未來家庭大小的不確定性。
blocks.en: The lifecycle approach is like the "rent vs. buy a home" decision: renting (SUS) means a low initial outlay and easy relocation, but higher monthly payments; buying (MUS) requires a large down payment and renovation costs, but long-term running costs may be lower. The best choice depends on how long you expect to stay, whether you may need to move, and the uncertainty about your future family size.

blocks.zh: 這段內容揭示了 SUS 的一個核心優勢：降低「彈性的成本」。在傳統 MUS 中，要獲得營運彈性需要額外的資本投資（備用設備、更大的設施等）；而 SUS 本身就具備彈性，不需要為「可能的擴產」預先投入鉅資。
blocks.en: This passage reveals a core advantage of SUS: it lowers the "cost of flexibility". With traditional MUS, obtaining operational flexibility requires additional capital investment (spare equipment, a larger facility, etc.); SUS is inherently flexible and does not require large advance investment for a "possible expansion".

blocks.zh: 這對新藥上市特別重要 — 在臨床階段需求不確定時，SUS 可以讓企業「量力而為」，等市場明確後再決定是否擴大規模。
blocks.en: This matters especially for new drug launches. When demand is uncertain during clinical stages, SUS lets a company "scale to its means" and decide whether to expand only once the market is clear.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 情境：你的公司正在開發一款新型生物製劑，Phase III 試驗結果將在 18 個月後揭曉。如果成功，預計需要年產 2,000 批；如果僅部分成功，可能只需 500 批。在這種不確定性下，SUS 的 lifecycle approach 建議你先以 SUS 設計啟動生產，避免在結果不確定時投入大量固定資產。
blocks.en: Scenario: Your company is developing a new biologic, and the Phase III results will be known in 18 months. If successful, you expect to need 2,000 batches per year; if only partially successful, perhaps only 500 batches. Under this uncertainty, the SUS lifecycle approach suggests starting production with an SUS design, avoiding a large investment in fixed assets while the outcome is unknown.

blocks.zh: Lifecycle approach 中的「decommissioning cost」包含哪些項目？為什麼 SUS 在這方面可能有優勢？
blocks.en: What items does "decommissioning cost" in the lifecycle approach include? Why might SUS have an advantage here?

blocks.zh: 在什麼情況下，即使 lifecycle approach 分析結果顯示 MUS 長期成本更低，企業仍可能選擇 SUS？
blocks.en: Under what circumstances might a company still choose SUS even when the lifecycle approach analysis shows that MUS has lower long-term cost?

blocks.zh: 6.3 Opportunity Cost 6.3 機會成本
blocks.en: 6.3 Opportunity Cost

blocks.zh: Opportunity Cost (機會成本)：在多個互斥選項中，選擇某一方案時所放棄的「次佳選項」的價值。這是經濟學的基本概念，但在製藥業的設施投資決策中經常被忽略，因為不同專案之間難以直接比較。
blocks.en: Opportunity Cost: The value of the "next-best alternative" given up when one of several mutually exclusive options is chosen. This is a basic economic concept, but it is often overlooked in facility investment decisions in the pharmaceutical industry because different projects are hard to compare directly.

blocks.zh: 假設你有 1,000 萬的資金。你可以用來擴建工廠 (A)、投資新藥研發 (B)、或委託 CMO 代工 (C)。如果你選了 A，那麼機會成本就是 B 和 C 中較好的那個選項所能帶來的收益。SUS 因為初始投資較低，可以讓你「多保留一些子彈」投入其他機會。
blocks.en: Suppose you have 10 million in capital. You could use it to expand the plant (A), invest in new drug R&D (B), or outsource to a CMO (C). If you choose A, the opportunity cost is the return from the better of B and C. Because SUS requires a lower initial investment, it lets you "keep more ammunition in reserve" for other opportunities.

blocks.zh: 機會成本之所以「經常被排除」在評估之外，是因為它需要對「沒走的那條路」做出假設性估算 — 這在大型製藥企業中特別困難，因為涉及的變數太多。然而，忽略機會成本可能導致企業過度投資於固定資產，而錯失更有價值的商業機會。
blocks.en: Opportunity cost is "often excluded" from evaluations because it requires a hypothetical estimate for "the road not taken", which is especially difficult in large pharmaceutical companies because so many variables are involved. However, ignoring opportunity cost can lead a company to over-invest in fixed assets and miss more valuable business opportunities.

blocks.zh: 為什麼機會成本在 CMO 的商業決策中特別重要？
blocks.en: Why is opportunity cost especially important in a CMO's business decisions?

blocks.zh: 如果你的企業決定不擴廠而改用 SUS，省下的資金可以用於哪些替代投資？
blocks.en: If your company decides to use SUS instead of expanding the plant, what alternative investments could the saved funds be used for?

blocks.zh: 6.4 Cost of Quality 6.4 品質成本
blocks.en: 6.4 Cost of Quality

blocks.zh: Cost of Quality (品質成本)：如果品質是完美的，就不需要花費的所有成本。包括預防成本、鑑定成本、內部失敗成本和外部失敗成本。SUS 可以降低某些品質成本（例如消除 CIP/SIP 驗證），但也引入新的品質成本（例如 E&L 研究）。
blocks.en: Cost of Quality: All the costs that would not need to be spent if quality were perfect. It includes prevention costs, appraisal costs, internal failure costs and external failure costs. SUS can reduce some costs of quality (for example, eliminating CIP/SIP validation) but also introduces new ones (for example, E&L studies).

blocks.zh: Extractables & Leachables (可萃取物與溶出物)：SUS 獨特的品質風險 — 塑膠材料中的化學物質可能溶出到製程液體中，影響產品品質和安全性。
blocks.en: Extractables & Leachables: A quality risk unique to SUS: chemicals in plastic materials may leach into the process fluid, affecting product quality and safety.

blocks.zh: 這段文字隱含一個關鍵風險：SUS 將品質保證的責任部分轉移給供應商。終端使用者依賴供應商的品質系統來管理次級供應商、監測 SUS 特有的失敗模式。這意味著：
blocks.en: This passage implies a key risk: SUS shifts part of the responsibility for quality assurance to the supplier. The end user relies on the supplier's quality system to manage sub-suppliers and to monitor SUS-specific failure modes. This means that:

blocks.zh: 供應商稽核 (supplier audit) 的深度和頻率必須加強
blocks.en: The depth and frequency of supplier audits must be increased

blocks.zh: 品質協議 (quality agreement) 必須涵蓋 SUS 特有的風險
blocks.en: The quality agreement must cover SUS-specific risks

blocks.zh: 供應商變更管控 (change control) 對終端使用者的影響需要持續監控
blocks.en: The impact of supplier change control on the end user needs to be monitored continuously

blocks.zh: 品質成本就像保險費：你付保險費 (預防成本) 是為了避免意外發生時的巨大損失 (失敗成本)。使用 SUS 就像將部分保險責任轉給供應商 — 你的保費可能降低，但如果供應商的「保險公司」不可靠，一旦出問題，損失可能更大。
blocks.en: Cost of quality is like an insurance premium: you pay the premium (prevention cost) to avoid a huge loss (failure cost) if an accident occurs. Using SUS is like transferring part of the insurance responsibility to the supplier: your premium may fall, but if the supplier's "insurer" is unreliable, the loss could be even greater when something goes wrong.

blocks.zh: SUS 的三種特有 failure modes（袋子破裂、E&L 變異、細胞生長影響）中，哪一種最難被供應商品質系統檢測到？為什麼？
blocks.en: Of the three SUS-specific failure modes (bag rupture, E&L variability, impact on cell growth), which is hardest for a supplier's quality system to detect, and why?

blocks.zh: 當供應商對 SUS 組件進行變更時，終端使用者需要進行哪些額外的 process compatibility 測試？
blocks.en: When a supplier makes a change to an SUS component, what additional process compatibility testing does the end user need to perform?

blocks.zh: 6.5 Quantitative Evaluation of Business Drivers 6.5 商業驅動因素之量化評估
blocks.en: 6.5 Quantitative Evaluation of Business Drivers

blocks.zh: Economic Model (經濟模型)：由多個子模型 (submodels) 組成的分析框架，用於量化比較 SUS 與 MUS 的總成本。子模型包括：Process Model（製程模型）、Operational Model（營運模型）、Facility Model（設施模型）、Capital Cost Model（資本成本模型）、Variable Cost Model（變動成本模型）、Fixed Cost Model（固定成本模型），最終整合為 Total Cost Model（總成本模型）。
blocks.en: Economic Model: An analytical framework made up of several submodels, used to quantitatively compare the total cost of SUS and MUS. The submodels include the Process Model, Operational Model, Facility Model, Capital Cost Model, Variable Cost Model and Fixed Cost Model, which are finally integrated into the Total Cost Model.

blocks.zh: 圖表解讀 Figure Analysis
blocks.en: Figure Analysis

blocks.zh: Figure 6.5-1 展示了一個層層遞進的成本模型架構：
blocks.en: Figure 6.5-1 shows a cost model architecture built up layer by layer:

blocks.zh: 第一層 (Process Model)：一切的基礎 — 先定義製程步驟、設備需求和批次規模
blocks.en: Layer 1 (Process Model): The foundation of everything: first define the process steps, equipment requirements and batch size

blocks.zh: 第二層 (Business/Operational/Facility)：將製程資訊轉化為營運場景和設施需求
blocks.en: Layer 2 (Business/Operational/Facility): Translates process information into operating scenarios and facility requirements

blocks.zh: 第三層 (Capital/Variable/Fixed Cost)：將場景轉化為具體的成本數據
blocks.en: Layer 3 (Capital/Variable/Fixed Cost): Translates the scenarios into concrete cost data

blocks.zh: 第四層 (Total Cost Model)：整合所有成本，輸出每批次平均成本
blocks.en: Layer 4 (Total Cost Model): Integrates all costs and outputs the average cost per batch

blocks.zh: 重要：不是所有專案都需要完整的六個子模型。對於初步可行性研究，只需 Process + Capital Cost + Variable Cost 三個子模型即可。
blocks.en: Important: Not every project needs all six submodels. For a preliminary feasibility study, only three submodels are needed: Process + Capital Cost + Variable Cost.

blocks.zh: 這個經濟模型就像蓋房子的預算規劃：先畫設計圖 (Process Model)，然後估算建材費 (Capital Cost)、每月水電費 (Variable Cost)、和物業管理費 (Fixed Cost)，最後加總得出每月居住成本。如果只是初步評估，你可能只需要建材費和水電費的大概數字。
blocks.en: This economic model is like budget planning for building a house: first draw the design plans (Process Model), then estimate the building materials (Capital Cost), the monthly utilities (Variable Cost) and the property management fees (Fixed Cost), and finally add them up to get the monthly cost of living. For a preliminary assessment, you may only need rough figures for materials and utilities.

blocks.zh: Batch Frequency (批次頻率) 是 SUS 經濟可行性的關鍵分水嶺：
blocks.en: Batch Frequency is the key dividing line for the economic viability of SUS:

blocks.zh: 高頻批次 = 耗材成本疊加，SUS 可能不划算
blocks.en: High batch frequency = consumable costs accumulate, so SUS may not be worthwhile

blocks.zh: 低頻/不規律批次 = SUS 優勢明顯，因固定成本低
blocks.en: Low or irregular batch frequency = SUS has a clear advantage because fixed costs are low

blocks.zh: 超大批次 = 可能超過 SUS 袋體容量限制，需要多個 SUS 組合，增加成本
blocks.en: Very large batches = may exceed the SUS bag volume limit, requiring multiple SUS assemblies and adding cost

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼 CMO 和臨床階段生產特別適合 SUS — 批次頻率低且難以預測。
blocks.en: This is why CMO and clinical-stage manufacturing are particularly well suited to SUS: batch frequency is low and hard to predict.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh: 簡化版成本比較思路：
blocks.en: A simplified approach to cost comparison:

blocks.zh:
SUS 每批次成本 = (固定成本/年批次數) + 變動成本/批次
MUS 每批次成本 = (固定成本/年批次數) + 變動成本/批次

SUS: 固定成本低，變動成本高 (耗材)
MUS: 固定成本高，變動成本低 (清洗/滅菌)

損益兩平點 = 固定成本差額 / 變動成本差額
blocks.en:
SUS cost per batch = (fixed cost / batches per year) + variable cost per batch
MUS cost per batch = (fixed cost / batches per year) + variable cost per batch

SUS: low fixed cost, high variable cost (consumables)
MUS: high fixed cost, low variable cost (cleaning/sterilization)

Break-even point = difference in fixed cost / difference in variable cost

blocks.zh: Table 6.5-1🔍 中的「Unit operation」因素指出大容量製程可能需要多個 SUS 袋體。這對設施分類 (classification) 有什麼影響？
blocks.en: The "Unit operation" factor in Table 6.5-1🔍 points out that large-volume processes may require multiple SUS bags. What does this mean for facility classification?

blocks.zh: 如果你的批次頻率為每年 200 批，批量為 500L，SUS 的經濟可行性評估應該重點關注哪些子模型？
blocks.en: If your batch frequency is 200 batches per year with a batch size of 500 L, which submodels should the SUS economic viability assessment focus on?

blocks.zh: 6.6 Operational Model 6.6 運營模型
blocks.en: 6.6 Operational Model

blocks.zh: Downtime (停機時間)：批次之間用於清洗、拆卸、滅菌、校準、測試、安裝和部署的時間。SUS 可以大幅縮短停機時間，因為省去了 CIP/SIP 步驟。
blocks.en: Downtime: The time between batches spent on cleaning, disassembly, sterilization, calibration, testing, installation and deployment. SUS can greatly reduce downtime because the CIP/SIP steps are eliminated.

blocks.zh: Changeover Duration (換線時間)：在不同產品或批次之間切換所需的時間。在多產品設施中，這通常是產能瓶頸。SUS 的「用完即丟」特性可以顯著縮短換線時間。
blocks.en: Changeover Duration: The time required to switch between different products or batches. In a multi-product facility, this is often the capacity bottleneck. The "use once and discard" nature of SUS can significantly shorten changeover time.

blocks.zh: Scrap Ratio (報廢率)：因污染、完整性喪失或其他問題而損失的批次比例。包含報廢所造成的材料和人工成本。
blocks.en: Scrap Ratio: The proportion of batches lost due to contamination, loss of integrity or other problems. It includes the material and labor costs caused by scrapping.

blocks.zh: Changeover 就像 F1 賽車的進站換胎 (pit stop)：傳統 MUS 的換線就像整台車要推進維修區徹底檢修（清洗、消毒、驗證），可能需要數天甚至數週；SUS 的換線就像直接換上全新的輪胎組，幾小時就能重新上路。在 CMO 這種「每場比賽換不同車隊」的環境中，進站速度直接決定勝負。
blocks.en: Changeover is like an F1 pit stop: a traditional MUS changeover is like pushing the whole car into the garage for a thorough overhaul (cleaning, sanitization, validation), which may take days or even weeks; an SUS changeover is like simply fitting a brand-new set of tires, getting back on track within hours. In a CMO, where "every race is with a different team", pit-stop speed decides who wins.

blocks.zh: Table 6.6-1🔍 中的「Batches per year」這一行揭示了一個經常被忽略的邏輯：SUS 的真正經濟價值不只在於降低每批次成本，更在於同一設施每年能生產更多批次。當固定成本被分攤到更多批次上時，每批次的固定成本分攤額會下降，這可能完全抵消 SUS 較高的耗材成本。
blocks.en: The "Batches per year" row in Table 6.6-1🔍 reveals a logic that is often overlooked: the real economic value of SUS lies not only in lowering the cost per batch, but also in allowing the same facility to produce more batches each year. When fixed costs are spread over more batches, the fixed cost allocated to each batch falls, which may completely offset the higher consumable cost of SUS.

blocks.zh: 情境：某 CMO 有一條多產品生產線，每年需要進行 12 次產品切換。MUS 每次換線需要 5 天（清洗+驗證），SUS 只需 1 天。這意味著 SUS 每年多出 48 個工作天，可額外生產約 15-20 個批次。這些額外批次的營收，往往遠超 SUS 的耗材成本增加。
blocks.en: Scenario: A CMO has a multi-product line that needs 12 product changeovers per year. Each MUS changeover takes 5 days (cleaning + validation), while SUS takes only 1 day. This means SUS frees up 48 additional working days per year, allowing roughly 15-20 additional batches to be produced. The revenue from these extra batches often far exceeds the increase in SUS consumable costs.

blocks.zh: Scrap ratio 對 SUS 和 MUS 的影響方式有何不同？（提示：SUS 的 scrap 成本主要是耗材，MUS 的 scrap 成本主要是什麼？）
blocks.en: How does scrap ratio affect SUS and MUS differently? (Hint: the scrap cost for SUS is mainly consumables; what is the main scrap cost for MUS?)

blocks.zh: 在單一產品設施中，SUS 的主要價值是減少 downtime 還是 changeover？為什麼？
blocks.en: In a single-product facility, is the main value of SUS reducing downtime or changeover? Why?

blocks.zh: 6.7 Total Cost Model 6.7 總成本模型
blocks.en: 6.7 Total Cost Model

blocks.zh: Retrofitting (改裝/翻新)：將現有設施改造以導入 SUS 技術，與新建設施有不同的考量重點。改裝受限於既有設施條件，但投資較低且能維持生產。
blocks.en: Retrofitting: Modifying an existing facility to introduce SUS technology, with different considerations from building a new facility. Retrofitting is constrained by existing facility conditions, but requires lower investment and allows production to continue.

blocks.zh: Shortcut Cost Model (簡化成本模型)：使用最少因素進行快速可行性判斷的方法，適合初步評估但不足以支持最終投資決策。
blocks.en: Shortcut Cost Model: A method that uses a minimum number of factors for a quick feasibility judgment. It is suitable for preliminary assessment but not sufficient to support a final investment decision.

blocks.zh: Sensitivity Analysis (敏感度分析)：透過改變模型中的輸入變數範圍，了解不同假設條件對結果的影響程度，識別哪些變數是影響 SUS 經濟可行性的關鍵。
blocks.en: Sensitivity Analysis: Varying the range of the model's input variables to understand how much different assumptions affect the result, and to identify which variables are critical to the economic viability of SUS.

blocks.zh: Table 6.7-1🔍 的對比非常實用：
blocks.en: The comparison in Table 6.7-1🔍 is very practical:

blocks.zh: 新建設施：可以從零設計為 SUS 最佳化，大幅縮減上市時間 (time to market)
blocks.en: New facility: Can be designed from scratch and optimized for SUS, greatly shortening time to market

blocks.zh: 改裝設施：重點在於克服現有產能限制，減少改裝期間的生產中斷
blocks.en: Retrofitted facility: The focus is on overcoming existing capacity constraints and minimizing production interruption during the retrofit

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO 而言，改裝往往是更常見的情境，因為完全停產建新廠的成本太高。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, retrofitting is often the more common scenario, because the cost of shutting down production entirely to build a new plant is too high.

blocks.zh: Shortcut Cost Model 的核心公式：
blocks.en: Core formulas of the Shortcut Cost Model:

blocks.zh:
COGM = (Total Operating Costs + Total Cost of Capital)
       / Number of Batches Produced

Payback Time = Difference in Investment Cost
             / Difference in COGM

其中：
  Total Cost of Capital = 年折舊 + 年利息
  Total Operating Costs = 耗材 + 材料 + 人工

範例：
  SUS 投資 = $2M, COGM = $15K/batch
  MUS 投資 = $8M, COGM = $18K/batch
  Payback = ($8M - $2M) / ($18K - $15K)
          = $6M / $3K = 2,000 batches
blocks.en:
COGM = (Total Operating Costs + Total Cost of Capital)
       / Number of Batches Produced

Payback Time = Difference in Investment Cost
             / Difference in COGM

Where:
  Total Cost of Capital = annual depreciation + annual interest
  Total Operating Costs = consumables + materials + labor

Example:
  SUS investment = $2M, COGM = $15K/batch
  MUS investment = $8M, COGM = $18K/batch
  Payback = ($8M - $2M) / ($18K - $15K)
          = $6M / $3K = 2,000 batches

blocks.zh: Shortcut Model vs Comprehensive Model 就像看病：快篩 (shortcut) 可以快速告訴你「可能有問題」或「看起來沒事」，但要確認診斷和制定治療方案，需要做完整的健康檢查 (comprehensive model)。Sensitivity analysis 則像壓力測試 — 看看在最壞的情況下，你的財務還撐得住嗎？
blocks.en: The Shortcut Model vs. the Comprehensive Model is like a medical visit: a rapid screening (shortcut) can quickly tell you "there may be a problem" or "it looks fine", but to confirm a diagnosis and plan treatment you need a full health check-up (comprehensive model). Sensitivity analysis is like a stress test: in the worst case, can your finances still hold up?

blocks.zh: 在 shortcut cost model 中，為什麼只需要四個最少因素（製程設備、公用設施設備、SU 耗材、資本成本假設）就能做出初步判斷？
blocks.en: In the shortcut cost model, why are only four minimum factors (process equipment, utility equipment, SU consumables, capital cost assumptions) enough for a preliminary judgment?

blocks.zh: 如果 sensitivity analysis 顯示 SUS 耗材價格波動 20% 會使 COGM 超過 MUS，你的建議是什麼？
blocks.en: If sensitivity analysis shows that a 20% fluctuation in SUS consumable prices would push COGM above that of MUS, what would you recommend?

blocks.zh: Payback time 計算結果為 2,000 批次時，對年產 100 批的企業和年產 500 批的企業分別意味著什麼？
blocks.en: When the payback time calculates to 2,000 batches, what does this mean for a company producing 100 batches per year compared with one producing 500 batches per year?

blocks.zh: 6.8 Investment Costs 6.8 投資成本
blocks.en: 6.8 Investment Costs

blocks.zh: Investment Costs (投資成本)：不只是設備採購價格，還包括公用設施、安裝、工程設計、試運轉 (commissioning)、驗證 (validation)、設施空間和操作人員等全面性的初始投入成本。
blocks.en: Investment Costs: More than just the equipment purchase price, these include the full range of initial outlay: utilities, installation, engineering design, commissioning, validation, facility space and operators.

blocks.zh: Indirect Equipment Costs (間接設備成本)：通常以設備成本的百分比來估算，包括設計、試運轉、確效和驗證費用。SUS 在安裝百分比上較低，但工程百分比可能較高（因基礎投資較低且需要 E&L 驗證）。
blocks.en: Indirect Equipment Costs: Usually estimated as a percentage of equipment cost, including design, commissioning, qualification and validation fees. SUS has a lower installation percentage, but its engineering percentage may be higher (because the base investment is lower and E&L validation is needed).

blocks.zh: FMEA (失效模式與效應分析)：系統性的風險評估工具，用於識別 SUS 的真實風險，避免過度設計 (overdesign) 導致的不必要成本。
blocks.en: FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis): A systematic risk assessment tool used to identify the real risks of SUS and avoid the unnecessary cost of overdesign.

blocks.zh: Table 6.8.1-1🔍 是投資成本評估的完整清單，特別注意以下經常被低估的因素：
blocks.en: Table 6.8.1-1🔍 is a complete checklist for investment cost assessment. Pay particular attention to the following factors, which are often underestimated:

blocks.zh: Commissioning：SUS 可以消除與 CIP/SIP 相關的 I/O 點，簡化自動化系統
blocks.en: Commissioning: SUS can eliminate the I/O points associated with CIP/SIP, simplifying the automation system

blocks.zh: Facility floor space：SUS 不僅影響生產區面積，還影響潔淨度分級和倉儲需求
blocks.en: Facility floor space: SUS affects not only the production area but also the cleanliness classification and storage requirements

blocks.zh: Operators：操作人員數量影響培訓成本、工作站和更衣室需求
blocks.en: Operators: The number of operators affects training costs, workstations and gowning room requirements

blocks.zh: 重點提示 - 設施與廢棄物
blocks.en: Key Notes: Facilities and Waste

blocks.zh: SUS 在設施方面的「空間節省」並非絕對：
blocks.en: The "space savings" SUS offers in a facility are not absolute:

blocks.zh: 省去 CIP/SIP 設備空間
blocks.en: Space for CIP/SIP equipment is eliminated

blocks.zh: 但增加 SUS 庫存倉儲空間
blocks.en: But storage space for SUS inventory increases

blocks.zh: 增加製程廢棄物暫存空間
blocks.en: Temporary storage space for process waste increases

blocks.zh: 增加運輸路線長度（相比硬管系統）
blocks.en: Transport route length increases (compared with hard-piped systems)

blocks.zh: 廢棄物處理的三種方式（廠內滅活、廠外焚化/掩埋、化學滅活）各有不同的成本和法規要求，必須符合當地主管機關的規定。
blocks.en: The three waste disposal methods (on-site inactivation, off-site incineration/landfill, chemical inactivation) each have different costs and regulatory requirements, and must comply with local authority regulations.

blocks.zh: SUS 耗材的成本估算就像裝修房子：供應商型錄上的「標準配置」價格和你實際需要的「客製化組合」可能天差地遠。就像你看到「基本裝修每坪 3 萬」，但加上你要的進口磁磚、隱藏式燈具、智能家居系統後，可能變成每坪 8 萬。所以 TR66 建議做 sensitivity analysis — 看看價格浮動對整體成本的影響有多大。
blocks.en: Estimating SUS consumable costs is like renovating a house: the "standard package" price in the supplier's catalog and the "customized combination" you actually need can be worlds apart. You may see "basic renovation at 30,000 per ping", but once you add the imported tiles, concealed lighting and smart-home system you want, it may become 80,000 per ping. That is why TR66 recommends sensitivity analysis: to see how much price fluctuation affects the overall cost.

blocks.zh: 情境：你正在評估將一條現有的不銹鋼緩衝液配製線轉換為 SUS。使用 Table 6.8.1-1🔍 作為檢查清單：
blocks.en: Scenario: You are evaluating converting an existing stainless steel buffer preparation line to SUS. Using Table 6.8.1-1🔍 as a checklist:

blocks.zh: Process equipment：需要採購袋體支架 (bag supports)、焊接機 (welders)、密封機 (sealers)
blocks.en: Process equipment: You need to purchase bag supports, welders and sealers

blocks.zh: Utility equipment：可以取消該線的 CIP 站，但需要評估 WFI 需求變化
blocks.en: Utility equipment: The CIP station for this line can be eliminated, but changes in WFI demand need to be evaluated

blocks.zh: Validation：需要進行 E&L 研究，但可以省去 CIP/SIP 驗證
blocks.en: Validation: E&L studies are needed, but CIP/SIP validation can be omitted

blocks.zh: Facility：生產區可能縮小，但需要增加 SUS 倉庫
blocks.en: Facility: The production area may shrink, but an SUS warehouse needs to be added

blocks.zh: 為什麼 SUS 的工程百分比成本 (engineering percentage) 可能高於 MUS？這是否意味著 SUS 的總投資成本更高？
blocks.en: Why might the engineering percentage cost of SUS be higher than that of MUS? Does this mean the total investment cost of SUS is higher?

blocks.zh: SUS 的廢棄物處理策略應該在專案的哪個階段就開始規劃？為什麼？
blocks.en: At which stage of the project should the SUS waste disposal strategy be planned, and why?

blocks.zh: Table 6.8.4-1🔍 中的五項變動成本，哪些在 SUS 中會增加，哪些會減少？
blocks.en: Of the five variable costs in Table 6.8.4-1🔍, which increase with SUS and which decrease?

blocks.zh: 6.9 QC/QA and Cost of Quality 6.9 QC/QA 與品質成本
blocks.en: 6.9 QC/QA and Cost of Quality

blocks.zh: Quality Oversight Activities (品質監管活動)：SUS 實施後增加的品質管理工作，包括：品質協議 (quality agreement)、供應商稽核 (supplier audit)、SUS 文件審查、次級供應商稽核 (subsupplier audit)、QC 進料檢驗 (receiving inspection)。這些是使用「外購即用型元件」必須承擔的品質管理成本。
blocks.en: Quality Oversight Activities: The additional quality management work required after SUS implementation, including: quality agreement, supplier audit, review of SUS documentation, subsupplier audit and QC receiving inspection. These are the quality management costs that must be borne when using "purchased ready-to-use components".

blocks.zh: QC/QA 成本的「一增一減」效應：
blocks.en: The "one up, one down" effect on QC/QA cost:

blocks.zh: 減少的成本：批次審查和調查工作量降低（因減少了清洗、SIP 和換線步驟的相關偏差調查）
blocks.en: Reduced cost: Less batch review and investigation work (because deviation investigations related to cleaning, SIP and changeover steps are reduced)

blocks.zh: 增加的成本：供應商品質監管工作增加（品質協議、稽核、文件審查、進料檢驗）
blocks.en: Increased cost: More supplier quality oversight work (quality agreement, audits, documentation review, receiving inspection)

blocks.zh: 複雜化的風險：當品質活動分散在供應商和終端使用者兩個品質系統中時，製程調查變得更複雜
blocks.en: Increased complexity: When quality activities are split across two quality systems, those of the supplier and the end user, process investigations become more complex

blocks.zh: 淨效益取決於企業的具體情況 — 如果供應商品質系統成熟可靠，SUS 的品質成本可能整體降低。
blocks.en: The net benefit depends on the company's specific situation. If the supplier's quality system is mature and reliable, the overall cost of quality for SUS may be lower.

blocks.zh: 這就像從「自家廚房煮飯」轉為「訂購外食便當」：你省去了洗碗、備料的時間（減少清洗/SIP 相關偏差），但需要檢查便當供應商的食安衛生（supplier audit）、確認食材來源（subsupplier audit）、收貨時驗收品質（receiving inspection）。如果便當出了問題，追查原因比自己煮出問題更困難（process investigations more complex）。
blocks.en: It is like moving from "cooking at home" to "ordering takeaway lunch boxes": you save the time spent washing dishes and preparing ingredients (fewer cleaning/SIP-related deviations), but you need to check the food safety and hygiene of the lunch box supplier (supplier audit), confirm the source of the ingredients (subsupplier audit), and check the quality on receipt (receiving inspection). If something goes wrong with the lunch box, tracing the cause is harder than if you had cooked it yourself (process investigations more complex).

blocks.zh: 為什麼「批次文件準備和批次放行」的成本在 SUS 和 MUS 之間差異不大？
blocks.en: Why is the cost of "batch documentation preparation and batch release" not very different between SUS and MUS?

blocks.zh: 如果你的 SUS 供應商在另一個國家，subsupplier audit 的挑戰會如何增加？這對品質成本有什麼影響？
blocks.en: If your SUS supplier is in another country, how do the challenges of a subsupplier audit increase? What does this mean for the cost of quality?

blocks.zh: 6.10 Fixed Operating Costs 6.10 固定運營成本
blocks.en: 6.10 Fixed Operating Costs

blocks.zh: Fixed Operating Costs (固定營運成本)：不論生產狀態如何（生產中、閒置、或維護中）都必須支出的設施費用。典型項目包括：設施租金/折舊、基礎人力、維護保養、保險、稅務等。SUS 因設施需求較小且設備較少，通常有較低的固定營運成本。
blocks.en: Fixed Operating Costs: Facility expenses that must be paid regardless of production status (in production, idle or under maintenance). Typical items include facility rent/depreciation, base staffing, maintenance, insurance and taxes. Because SUS needs less facility space and less equipment, it generally has lower fixed operating costs.

blocks.zh: 固定成本的特性是「無論你生產 0 批還是 100 批，都必須支付」。這就是為什麼批次頻率低時 SUS 更有優勢 — SUS 的固定成本較低，即使產量不高也不會造成過大的經濟壓力。反之，MUS 的高固定成本需要透過大量批次來分攤，閒置設備等於「燒錢」。
blocks.en: The nature of a fixed cost is that "you must pay it whether you produce 0 batches or 100". This is why SUS has the advantage when batch frequency is low: its fixed costs are lower, so even low output does not create excessive financial pressure. Conversely, the high fixed costs of MUS must be spread over a large number of batches, and idle equipment is "burning money".

blocks.zh: 固定營運成本就像你的手機月租費 — 不管你打了多少電話，每個月都要付。MUS 就像高額月租方案（設備折舊、CIP 系統維護、大型設施維護），SUS 就像低月租但通話費較高的方案。當你通話量 (批次數) 不確定時，低月租方案風險較低。
blocks.en: Fixed operating costs are like your monthly phone plan fee: you pay it every month no matter how many calls you make. MUS is like a high-fee plan (equipment depreciation, CIP system maintenance, maintenance of a large facility), and SUS is like a low-fee plan with higher call charges. When your call volume (number of batches) is uncertain, the low-fee plan carries less risk.

blocks.zh: 列舉三項在 SUS 實施後可能降低的固定營運成本，並說明原因。
blocks.en: List three fixed operating costs that may fall after SUS implementation and explain why.

blocks.zh: 在什麼情境下，SUS 的固定營運成本可能反而高於 MUS？（提示：考慮倉儲和庫存管理。）
blocks.en: Under what circumstances might the fixed operating costs of SUS actually be higher than those of MUS? (Hint: consider storage and inventory management.)

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 商業驅動因素多元：SUS 採用不只是成本考量，還涉及供應商能力、產品可持續性、業務連續性、製程設計、市場規模、設施和地點等八大因素，每家企業的評估重點不同。
blocks.en: Business drivers are diverse: Adopting SUS is not only a cost consideration; it also involves eight factors, including supplier capability, product sustainability, business continuity, process design, market size, facility and location. Each company's evaluation focus differs.

blocks.zh: 生命週期方法 (Lifecycle Approach)：評估應涵蓋從建設到除役的完整生命週期成本，SUS 在需求不確定和需要營運彈性時特別有利。
blocks.en: Lifecycle Approach: The evaluation should cover the full lifecycle cost from construction to decommissioning. SUS is particularly advantageous when demand is uncertain and operational flexibility is needed.

blocks.zh: 經濟模型層層建構：從 Process Model 到 Total Cost Model，由多個子模型組成。初步評估可用 Shortcut Model，最終決策需要 Comprehensive Model + Sensitivity Analysis。
blocks.en: The economic model is built up in layers: From the Process Model to the Total Cost Model, it consists of several submodels. A Shortcut Model can be used for a preliminary assessment; the final decision requires a Comprehensive Model + Sensitivity Analysis.

blocks.zh: COGM 與 Payback Time：核心公式為 COGM = (營運成本 + 資本成本) / 批次數；Payback = 投資差額 / COGM 差額。批次頻率是決定 SUS 經濟可行性的關鍵變數。
blocks.en: COGM and Payback Time: The core formulas are COGM = (operating costs + capital costs) / number of batches; Payback = difference in investment / difference in COGM. Batch frequency is the key variable determining the economic viability of SUS.

blocks.zh: 投資成本評估全面性：不僅比較設備價格，還須考慮公用設施、安裝、工程、試運轉、驗證、設施空間和人員等因素。SUS 安裝百分比低但工程百分比可能高。
blocks.en: Investment cost assessment must be comprehensive: Do not compare equipment prices alone; also consider utilities, installation, engineering, commissioning, validation, facility space and personnel. SUS has a low installation percentage but its engineering percentage may be high.

blocks.zh: 品質成本一增一減：SUS 減少了清洗/SIP 相關的調查成本，但增加了供應商監管成本。當品質活動分散在兩個品質系統中時，製程調查變得更複雜。
blocks.en: Cost of quality: one up, one down: SUS reduces investigation costs related to cleaning/SIP but increases supplier oversight costs. When quality activities are split across two quality systems, process investigations become more complex.

blocks.zh: 固定成本優勢：SUS 通常具有較低的固定營運成本，在批次頻率低或不確定的情境下特別有利。
blocks.en: Fixed cost advantage: SUS generally has lower fixed operating costs, which is particularly advantageous when batch frequency is low or uncertain.
